architectureDecisions: D1 — Add deliver --trace-dir <dir> [--arm <label>] help and forwarding in bin. commandDeliver normalizes traceDir/trace-dir to runDeliverSlice options. Options-only: DELIVER_SLICE_V1 remains unchanged. Default arm EXHARNESS_SUPERVISED matches run. Invalid/empty/non-string traceDir or arm and arm without traceDir fail DELIVER_SLICE_V1 validation before spawn; bin maps to usage exit 64.

D2 — Lazily create observation in runDeliverSlice only on a branch that can invoke Backend, using its exact resolved adapter, slice.id, arm, createRunTraceWriter({dir:traceDir}) and invocation env. Pass invocationObserver/eventSinks/tracer together to all three fresh/durable/resume callsites. Missing executable, terminal handle and accepted-handle QA construct no writer; omitted traceDir preserves omitted hooks.

D3 — Await finalize once after Backend returns, before finishBackend starts QA or disposes recovery. EXHAUSTED/timed-out attempts retain factual traces; TOOL_UNAVAILABLE can have a failure trace only if its observer actually ran. Do not trace probes/QA or change slice result fields. Observer/finalizer errors reject the slice; already-written lines remain factual evidence.

D4 — Wrap the observer and record attempt indices only after successful capture. For ACT_COMPLETED resume, exclude only the known first skipped ACT from the finalizer input when not observed in this process. Keep original result/QA unchanged. All other missing bodies remain errors; ATTEMPT_COMPLETED resume remains strict. Filtered attempt count/order aligns capture.windows with actual ACTs; retain original indices, assign a fresh process runId, and skip finalize for an empty observed set. Never reconstruct old timing/output/usage. This observed-only proposal does not resolve crash-spanning completeness: R1 blocks READY.

D5 — Reuse the writer for sequential deliver/resume calls, preserving sequence/prevDigest across processes. Verify before append; do not truncate or repair broken chains. Delivered queue is process-local, without concurrent-writer or exactly-once crash guarantees. An invocation lost before finalize has no durable record.

D6 — Before spawn/writer creation, resolve traceDir relative to process cwd and check real-path containment against source, recoveryDir and known worktrees. For nonexistent paths, resolve nearest existing real ancestor plus remaining segments. Reject equal/descendant destinations and symlink aliases. External output survives cleanup; this placement rule does not sandbox the agent.

D7 — Reuse parser/redaction/report modules unchanged. Execution and capture receive the same env for secret redaction. Retain SUPERVISED mode, slice taskId, actual tool/version, per-attempt verification/diff and Core summaries. DESCRIPTIVE report and invocation COMPLETED status never authorize slice acceptance.

D8 — Future tests use isolated temporary Git repos and delivered fake fixtures without credentials. API tests directly invoke runDeliverSlice; CLI tests spawn the real bin/report. Distinct negative titles directly invoke their bound subject. Assert source snapshots, verified trace bytes and actual fake invocation counts; collect candidate-bound logs. Proposed tests are not claimed to exist/pass.

D9 — Use OBJECTIVE_SCOPED_V1 routing with exact objective strings and baseline-grounded anchors. Preserve canonical graph baseline separately from inspected main. Retain researchGaps and issue no readiness judgment. Resolve gaps and obtain fresh independent Jev SATISFIED before Worker.

S2 — Wire three Backend callsites with the observation hook bundle; finalize before QA/disposal. Filter only the known skipped resume ACT; preserve strict missing-body errors. Leave supervisor/recovery/observation/writer/report unchanged.

S3 — Add API fixtures for fresh retries/exhaustion, durable completion, both resume phases, unavailable tool, accepted-handle QA, preservation, containment, secrets and trace errors. Reuse fixtures read-only; inline child crash code in tests.
S4 — Add actual bin fixtures for trace-dir/default/custom arm, sequential append and report counts; corrupt-chain report, arm-only usage and observation errors cannot print acceptance.

S5 — Update Living docs with flags, Backend-only capture, output placement, failures, serialization and ratified crash limits. Run focused/regression checks and collect independent candidate-bound evidence.
